reviewer_agreement.title: Transient sub-120px hit window for NEW GAME during pop-in before the proxy wraps
reviewer_agreement.detail: Both lenses independently traced the same window: _open_popup retires the proxy, the 110px button stays live through the pop-in tween (scale 0.9 ≈ 99px) and the settle loop before wrap(). Disclosed in the PR body as an accepted trade-off.

verdict_justification: 0 blockers across 7 lenses on 10 findings (all confirmed, none rejected). 3 warnings: the transient sub-120px NEW GAME window (disclosed trade-off, two-lens agreement), untested dominant-button press dispatch, and the advisory gate at CONCERNS. 6 notes: doc-drift and latent-guard nits.
